analysis:
The PR is a documentation-only change to docs/reference/protocol-messages.md. Visible hunks: the date bump on line 3, and a table row at about lines 1147-1153 documenting GLM5Next reasoning request controls. The new row says `reasoning: null` and null members are unset, that `reasoning.summary`/`generate_summary` accept auto, concise or detailed as no-ops, and that other `reasoning` members are refused. The supplied units are base text of lines 1-325 and 326-582. The changed lines (~1147+) fall outside the supplied base units, and the patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not see the full head text of the changed rows.

No controls were changed. The documented behavior is a request-parsing contract in GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift. It is conservative: unknown members are refused, and the summary values are accepted as no-ops. I found no new attack surface, no weakening of the fail-closed posture on A-001, no change to attestation/authorization (TB-011, T-053), and no change to the prefix-cache or at-rest posture (T-041). The base text I reviewed (resume protocol, drain barrier, heartbeat telemetry) is unchanged by this PR.

Remaining question: the real provider code in GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift was not supplied, so I cannot verify that it matches the documented behavior (e.g. that unknown `reasoning` members are actually refused). This is a doc-accuracy concern rather than a demonstrated security regression, so I record it as an unverified contract and raise no finding.
